The agreement ran September 3, 2025 through May 20, 2026, and the Board is ratifying it after it began.

enrichment.summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will develop data tracking systems and provide staff training and data services for Rudsdale Continuation High School's student support, attendance and academic counseling teams. outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $25,000 for mentorship for young women at LIFE Academy
enrichment.summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will offer mentorship and support to 75 to 100 Latinx young women in grades 6-12 at LIFE Academy, using support circles and somatic exercises to support mental health and mindfulness. outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The district is hiring the Oakland Public Education Fund to teach two media elective classes, Video Production of MetWest Live and Yearbook, at MetWest High School on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
